newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson reiterates growth forecast.
newsitem.headline: Dickson reiterates growth forecast.

text.p: Hong Kong retailer Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd reiterated on Friday it expected double-digit earnings growth for the fiscal year ending March 31.

"All subsidiaries around the world are operating profitably and the group expects to achieve double-digit growth in profits and earnings for the full year," chairman Dickson Poon told a news conference.
Poon said at the news conference earlier on Friday that Dickson had submitted a proposal to acquire the business and assets of U.S. luxury retailer Barney's Inc.

"Should the bid for Barney's be successful, the group will remain in an ideal position to take advantage of any other additional and suitable investment opportunities which might arise, and to ensure continued strong profits growth in the coming year," Poon said.
The company would continue to examine the further strengthening of its recurring income base and the enhancing of its financial position, he said.
Dickson Concepts has a worldwide retail network of more than 270 outlets and expects that number to exceed 300 by the end of 1997.
Poon said the group had opened 89 outlets around the world during the current financial year, well above the initial plan of 60 new shops.
